summary: Funday is a Melbourne-founded better-for-you candy brand (est. 2020) that launched into 1,300 US Target stores on 13 September 2026. Kylie Peck is its part-time Head of Finance (since Oct 2023) and the finance team has added a Commercial Accountant. Founder Daniel Kitay has spoken publicly about stock cycles, payment terms and cash flow pressure from growth.
